system.description: This power allows the thaumaturge to delve into the mind of a sleeping subject, gleaning the same kind of allegorical images as Portents, but for someone else's future rather than her own. The subject must be asleep and in the thaumaturge's presence (or the thaumaturge may be Psychically Projected); using this on Kindred costs one Willpower Trait. This power requires the presence of a Storyteller or Narrator to provide results, and requires at least five minutes of dreamlike trance beforehand.
